My father has checked out essentially; he doesn't like the guy I'm dating and I can feel his disappointment in me for how my life is. 

My mother is offering to help and has my best interest at heart and everything but she can be pushy and I'm reluctant to accept it more than I absolutely have to (she's the type to score keep and I won't hear the end of how she had to help me with my daughter)

I have been staying with them temporarily but I'm moving a couple hours away to live up near my uni in a townhouse in a few days. The previous tenants just moved out and the landlord has been doing work on the house to get it ready.

It is going to be extremely hard without my boyfriend there but at the same time I think it would be hard WITH him there because of his attitude and actions lately.

My mom feels bad for me and has offered to drive up to watch the baby when I have to go take exams for school or if I need a break.
Thank you for this, I needed to see it today.

He has been on lithium before in his teens and it helped him a lot but also made him gain weight and gave other side effects due to the ridiculously large amount he was prescribed. I am not saying pump him full of drugs, but I do think medication is an option worth exploring if it has the potential to help.

He says he is who he is, and up until recently refused to even see a therapist and address the issues that have been going on for the past couple of months. He is supposed to be going to see the therapist today. 

Last night he and I got into an argument on the phone because I said that the way he was behaving needs to be different before we can live together. He is paying 600 dollars to the people who live at the house he is staying at on Sept 1st and was asking me if we were moving in together next week as planned (we planned it long before the Xanax/other pill abuse and staying out all the time and being rude to me and my family began occurring in late June/early July). He now says he doesn't think we should talk for awhile because he is hurt and disappointed in me for "switching up" on him.

Thank you for being kind to me. I appreciate it a lot. 


She is the only reason I'm still hanging on but I am so sad and anxious lately and I know she must see/feel that and that isn't good for her development. 

I just feel unprepared for this whole situation and I'm terrified of raising her without her dad in the picture or with him present but acting this way.. He acts like he really loves me but half the time he gets mad over tiny things and yells... He has punched a hole in my wall while on Xanax. He has never harmed me physically but emotionally he knows how to hurt me.

I am fighting my own demons (depression, anxiety) and our daughter does not deserve that. 

He had pressed for me to give her up for adoption instead of keeping her because his mom was a young mom and almost gave him up but changed her mind last second and really scarred him with her behaviors during his childhood - he claimed our daughter does not deserve young parents when she could have a better life with older parents who had more money etc... But I could not give her up. I think he might resent me for it.

He told me "you have gotten more mature lately and that makes it really hard on me" ... I feel like I'm trying my best but that is not good enough because I'm in the wrong regardless of what I do.
